LESSON: CONSUMER EDUCATION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Home Management
Topic 2.6: Consumer Education
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Consumer Education, part of Home Management in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How is knowledge of consumer education applied in life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the importance of consumer education in day-to-day life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Consumer Education in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. analyse aspects of consumer awareness in consumer education,

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Consumer Education together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: the learner exhibits confidence when role-playing aspects of consumer education.

● Learning to Learn: the learner organises their own learning as they search for information on aspects of consumer

awareness in consumer education.

Values:
● Unity: the learners display team spirit as they role play on aspects of consumer education.

● Respect: learners appreciate diverse opinions when discussing the importance of consumer education.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy: the learners are made aware of the principles of wise buying and how to apply them in day-to-day

life.
